#Module mse

Media Source Extensions: MediaSource, SourceBuffer and SourceBufferList (src/page/media_source.odin). A SourceBuffer holds the coded frames a container parser made of what scripts appended (src/media), which a media element plays; the objects are EventTargets: sourceopen / sourceended / sourceclose, updatestart / update / updateend / error / abort, addsourcebuffer / removesourcebuffer are events of the host objects. In a dedicated worker the same functions drive a MediaSource whose media element is in the page (src/page/mse_worker.odin): its MediaSourceHandle is transferred to the page and set as the element's srcObject.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/media_source.widl.

Odin: import "wren:mse".

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_MediaSource).

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_SourceBuffer).

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_SourceBufferList).

#handle MediaSourceHandle : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_MediaSourceHandle).

#MediaSource_registerObjectURL

void MediaSource_registerObjectURL(MediaSource source, string url) raises

URL.createObjectURL(mediaSource): the URL (of the page's origin) is registered, so that a media element whose src is that URL plays this source. Called by the engine with the URL it made. NotSupported for a worker's MediaSource.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: MediaSource_registerObjectURL :: proc(c: ^Call, source: Api_MediaSource, url: string) -> Api_Error
